meaning: DIP_TIME fixes the "dip" marker on every P-V panel at a default of 352 s, a time taken from the postural tilt transient, unless `_DIP_T` overrides it. The marker is purely an annotation: if 352 s falls outside a deck's drawn window the dot is skipped, not clamped.

could_move.what: Any P-V panel in the jugular-compression decks, whose protocol is not postural, can get a dot at 352 s that sits on the curve but marks nothing physiological — the number is justified only for tilt decks.
Figures in the CIS report (jug-* figures) inherit whatever _DIP_T was set in the environment at render time; a shell without the variable silently re-uses 352 s.
The comment states TILT_XL finds tilt onset at ~346 s and the dip lands just after. If the tilt protocol timing changes in a deck, 352 s no longer tracks it and the comment becomes a stale claim.

expectation: Annotation only — no effect on solved states or fitted parameters. Effect is on figure reading: a possibly misplaced or absent marker. Whether 352 s is still the right instant for any given deck I cannot tell from this context.

check.why: Re-renders the panels with the dip marker disabled. Comparing against the default render shows exactly which decks carry a 352 s dot and whether it lands anywhere meaningful, without re-fitting. Adjust the entry script if panels_deck.jl is not directly runnable.
